cost_model.funding: Binance fundingRate events; approximate mark uses hourly close

data_source.selection: sum daily kline quote_volume over the latest 30 closed UTC daily bars; includes TRADING futures with contractType PERPETUAL or TRADIFI_PERPETUAL and quoteAsset USDT or USDC

notes: This is a transfer diagnostic, not a parameter search and not a promotion review.
The script downloads fresh Binance public API data at run time and performs in-script quality gates instead of promoting data into the repository data lake.
Funding PnL uses Binance funding timestamps with hourly close as the mark approximation.
The implementation follows the V7.1 external reproduction spec; exact legacy HYPE dynamic-code engine is not reused for non-HYPE symbols.
purpose: Cross-asset diagnostic of registered HYPE-1D-MA7-ABT-V7.1 rules on top 15 Binance U-margined futures, including USDT/USDC perpetuals and TradFi perpetuals, by recent 30 closed daily quote volume.
